justification: A shows a single isolated head with brow ridge, nose, and lips reduced to broad schematic ridges, while B shows a multi-register composition of animals (a bird-like creature, quadrupeds, a snake-like form), a band of chevrons, and repeated H-like signs on a pillar-like slab. The only real correspondence is the presence of a schematic anthropomorphic head/face element and generally simplified relief carving; there is no shared scene, no shared animal iconography, and no comparable arrangement of elements.
